spec.problem: Nine pending Admin exercise APIs require one-by-one contract and security verification. Current mutation routes lack admin.content.write/CSRF middleware, create defaults a UUID-backed source_id to non-UUID text, JSON fields and text-array tags do not follow the Prisma contract, writes ignore audit/delete errors, and read handlers suppress row/query errors.

acceptance.text: Exercise list, detail, performance analytics and config list return persisted, correctly typed contracts; read/query/scan errors are not silently converted to success.

Exercise create/update/delete and config upsert/delete are individually exercised through METHOD+PATH; unsafe writes require admin.content.write and trusted-origin CSRF; writes persist with exactly one audit event atomically.
Create accepts schema-valid JSON prompt/choices/correctAnswer and string-array tags; detail/list/update preserve JSON and tag types; missing IDs return 404 without audit or mutation.
A headed browser with a real Admin session observes every exercised request and its response; safe fixtures are removed after persistence verification.
Deleting an exercise with answer history returns 409 without deleting the exercise, answers or writing a delete audit; an unanswered disposable exercise can still be deleted and audited.
Admin exercise/config validation and defaults match packages/shared schemas, including valid enums/ranges, enabled=true and pointsPerCorrect=10 defaults.
Exercise prompt and correctAnswer inputs must be JSON objects and choices must be a JSON array on create/update; null or incompatible shapes return 400 before persistence.
API integration fixtures snapshot and restore any preexisting exercise_config row; cleanup never removes unrelated seeded configuration.

Admin exercise configuration table headers render inside a header row without hydration warnings, and the table stays within the 390px page width with its overflow available through a horizontally scrollable table region.

spec.expected_behavior: Admin exercise APIs expose database-backed JSON and config contracts. Mutations must be role-protected, CSRF-checked, and atomic with audit records. Use isolated UUID-backed exercise/config fixtures, invoke each method/path separately, verify status/body/DB effects, and clean up.
spec.observed_behavior: Current write routes are registered without permission/CSRF wrappers; some handlers ignore query/scan/Exec/audit failures; exercise JSON and tags types diverge from Prisma; sourceId defaults to non-UUID "admin"; update/delete can report success and write audit for missing rows.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert only AUDIT-124 handler/router/test changes and audit checkpoint. Test/browser fixtures are prefixed, isolated and explicitly cleaned; no canonical authored exercises are modified.

classification.rationale: Correct Admin exercise API authorization, schema-aligned contracts, SQL error handling and atomic audit semantics.

The refactor also consolidates four duplicate audit INSERT literals into the single transaction helper. The generated checkable-SQL floor therefore moves from 1155 to 1151 and removes only those two resolved drift signatures; the generated baseline test passes against all migrations.
